in_marathi.name: Gurunath
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Learner of the Truth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gurunath हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who is constantly engaged in learning the Truth. Derived from 'Guru' meaning teacher, and 'Nath' meaning master or lord.

in_bengali.name: Gurunath
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Learner of the Truth
in_bengali.long_meaning: Gurunath একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who is constantly engaged in learning the Truth. Derived from 'Guru' meaning teacher, and 'Nath' meaning master or lord.
